WITH ev AS (
  SELECT party_id, MAX(business_date) AS business_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'seated' THEN occurred_at END) AS seated_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'greeted' THEN occurred_at END) AS greeted_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'ordered' THEN occurred_at END) AS ordered_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'fired' THEN occurred_at END) AS fired_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'bumped' THEN occurred_at END) AS bumped_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'delivered' THEN occurred_at END) AS delivered_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'paid' THEN occurred_at END) AS paid_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'left' THEN occurred_at END) AS left_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'reset' THEN occurred_at END) AS reset_at
  FROM svc_pg.table_events GROUP BY party_id),
bo AS (
  SELECT ev.party_id, COUNT(b.staff_id) AS bussers_on FROM ev
  JOIN svc_fs.shifts b ON b.role = 'busser' AND CAST(b.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(ev.business_date AS DATE)
    AND CAST(ev.left_at AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(b.start_time AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST(ev.left_at AS TIMESTAMP) < CAST(b.end_time AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ev.party_id),
base AS (
  SELECT t.ticket_id, CAST(t.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date, t.service, dayofweek(CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)) AS dow,
    s.section_id AS section, CAST(s.tables_assigned AS INT) AS tables_per_server,
    (CAST(t.total AS DOUBLE) - CAST(t.comp_total AS DOUBLE)) AS revenue,
    CASE WHEN CAST(t.comp_total AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS comped,
    (hour(CAST(ev.seated_at AS TIMESTAMP)) * 60 + minute(CAST(ev.seated_at AS TIMESTAMP))) AS seated_tod, (hour(CAST(ev.left_at AS TIMESTAMP)) * 60 + minute(CAST(ev.left_at AS TIMESTAMP))) AS left_tod,
    (unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.greeted_at AS TIMESTAMP)) - unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.seated_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 60.0 AS greet_min,
    (unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.delivered_at AS TIMESTAMP)) - unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 60.0 AS order_to_delivery_min,
    (unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.bumped_at AS TIMESTAMP)) - unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.fired_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 60.0 AS kitchen_min,
    (unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.reset_at AS TIMESTAMP)) - unix_timestamp(CAST(ev.left_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 60.0 AS reset_min,
    COALESCE(bo.bussers_on, 0) AS bussers_on
  FROM svc_pg.pos_tickets t
  JOIN ev ON ev.party_id = t.party_id
  JOIN svc_fs.shifts s ON s.role = 'server' AND s.staff_id = t.server_id
    AND CAST(s.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)
    AND CAST(t.opened_at AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(s.start_time AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST(t.opened_at AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(s.end_time AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN bo ON bo.party_id = t.party_id)
